name: Title Case Converter
description: English title capitalization and text case conversion in the browser.
price: Free for the current web tool
processing: Browser-side deterministic rules; the tool does not upload or save input, output, or preferred spellings. Website hosting requests still occur.
language_scope: English-focused; not complete Unicode or locale-sensitive case conversion
known_limits: Editorial review needed for context-dependent words, unusual names, and compounds
Does not generate titles, check grammar, or format complete citations
Plain text only; no spreadsheet or document upload
disclosure: Maintainer-authored product documentation; not an independent review or publisher certification. Application source code is not included in this documentation repository.
